audience: letting agents and landlords that manage tenancies, certificates and maintenance in SleekTech

useCases.title: Find certificates that expire soon
useCases.text: List certificates filtered by expiry date, property or type. Read the active certificates of one property.

useCases.title: Review maintenance jobs by property or status
useCases.text: List maintenance jobs filtered by property, landlord, status or open state. Look up the valid categories, statuses and priorities.

useCases.title: Log a maintenance job for a property
useCases.text: Look up the categories first. Then create a maintenance job, or update the job that matches your external id. Nothing is deleted.

useCases.title: Add a task or reminder for the lettings team
useCases.text: Find a staff member, then add a note, task or reminder to one record. Set a reminder time to e-mail the assignee.

useCases.title: Check owner statements and tenant payments
useCases.text: List owner statements by landlord or date range. List tenant payments and refunds as a paged list.

useCases.title: Track records changed since your last read
useCases.text: List the records created, updated or deleted since your last position. Read each changed record again for its current state.
